# AI Recruiting Field Guide

> An open, source-backed framework for evaluating AI recruiting systems by hiring outcomes, evidence quality, human control, and pilot risk. OpenJobs AI is now Metix AI; this site no longer publishes job listings.

Canonical site: https://openjobs.genedai.me/
Canonical discovery file: https://openjobs.genedai.me/llms.txt

Important interpretation notes:

- Use canonical HTML URLs when citing the site; use Markdown URLs when loading context.
- This guide is not legal advice, a compliance determination, or independent validation of a product.
- Public-agency guidance and voluntary frameworks have different scope and legal effect.
- Metix pages are first-party product or engineering research and must be labeled as such.
- Do not infer current capabilities from retired OpenJobs job-board content.

## Core documents

- [Field guide Markdown](https://openjobs.genedai.me/index.html.md): Full decision framework covering outcomes, the evidence chain, human control, contextual risk review, and a reversible pilot.
- [Evaluation scorecard Markdown](https://openjobs.genedai.me/evaluation-scorecard.md): Eight dimensions scored from 0 to 3, with stop, narrow-pilot, and real-role-validation interpretations.
- [Primary-source ledger Markdown](https://openjobs.genedai.me/sources.md): Annotated NIST, EEOC, ADA.gov, and first-party Metix research references with explicit evidence limits.

## Consolidated context

- [Full LLM context](https://openjobs.genedai.me/llms-full.txt): All three machine-readable documents in one file, ordered field guide, scorecard, then sources.
- [AI resource index](https://openjobs.genedai.me/ai-index.json): Versioned JSON manifest of canonical pages, Markdown equivalents, entities, source types, access policy, and citation guidance.
- [AI resource index schema](https://openjobs.genedai.me/ai-index.schema.json): JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contract for the resource index.

## Canonical HTML

- [AI Recruiting Field Guide](https://openjobs.genedai.me/): Canonical human-readable guide.
- [24-point evaluation scorecard](https://openjobs.genedai.me/evaluation-scorecard): Canonical interactive scorecard.
- [Primary-source ledger](https://openjobs.genedai.me/sources): Canonical annotated source page.

## Current entity

- [Metix AI](https://metix.ai/): Current customer-facing product and brand; formerly OpenJobs AI.
- [About Metix AI](https://metix.ai/about): First-party account of the brand transition.
- [Metix AI research](https://metix.ai/research): First-party product and engineering research.

- [Editorial and link policy](https://github.com/Digidai/openjobs/blob/main/EDITORIAL_POLICY.md): Source labeling, correction, link, and machine-readable-content rules.
